## Dungeon Chess (Two Player (20×8))

{{svg:two-player-board.svg "Dungeon Chess (Two Player (20×8)) — starting position"}}

The standard two-player Dungeon Chess map. A long 20×8 corridor forces linear engagements with limited flanking space. Deploy zones at each end of the board.

### Map Features

- **Narrow corridor:** 8 ranks wide promotes head-on confrontations
- **Extended depth:** 20 files gives significant manoeuvre distance
- **Deploy zones:** At opposing short edges of the board

### Differences from Standard

The elongated shape changes the game's character. Ranged units and those with long-distance movement gain significant value. Flanking is difficult due to the narrow width, so frontal breakthrough becomes the primary strategy.
